text:
Sophie: Hey team, noticed a spike of 401 invalid_api_key errors from mobile users after SSO. Only happens when users sign in via the embedded WebView redirect.
Grant: Any repro steps or a minimal trace?
Sophie: Repro steps:
1) User signs in via SSO web flow
2) IdP redirects to our app: myapp://callback?api_key=AB+C%2Fxyz==&state=...
3) Our Android SDK calls Redwood with Authorization: Bearer <extracted_key> and gets 401.
Grant: Can you paste the extraction code (redact key) and the outgoing header?
Sophie: Extraction snippet: ```java
String apiKey = Uri.parse(intent.getData().toString()).getQueryParameter("api_key");
```
Outgoing header (redacted): `Authorization: Bearer AB C/xyz==` (note the space).
Anita: That header shows a space where the `+` should be. On Android `getQueryParameter` treats querystring as application/x-www-form-urlencoded and decodes `+` -> space. If the key legitimately contains `+` (common in non-url-safe Base64) it becomes corrupted.
Sophie: Oh wow, I didn't realize `+` would be turned into space. On some IdP redirects the `+` is left unencoded.
Grant: Quick check: if you manually replace the space back to `+` and retry, does it succeed?
Sophie: Yes — I replaced space with `+` locally and the call returns 200.
EngOps: Short-term workaround: have the redirect URL percent-encode `+` as `%2B` (IdP side). Longer-term: update SDK to parse raw query string without form-decoding or move the token into URL fragment so `+` is preserved.
support-bot: Ticket #3125 created (mobile-auth) — assigned to Grant.
Anita: Suggested SDK change (for Android): use `intent.getData().getQuery()` and manual split on `&`/`=` without form-decoding, then decode percent-escapes but keep `+` literal, or use URL-safe Base64 in the redirect.
Grant: I'll add a small canary patch to the Android SDK to preserve `+` for `api_key` param and add an integration test for redirects from IdPs that send `+`.
Sophie: Added logs and a repro build (internal) — sending to QA.
EngOps: Also added a short monitoring alert for increase in invalid_api_key rate coming from mobile callback useragents.
Sophie: Thanks everyone — this explains the intermittent failures we saw across Android versions.
Grant: Marking as resolved here once the SDK canary is validated. Will update ticket #3125.
Sophie: :thumbsup:
support-bot: Ticket #3125 status -> awaiting verification
